apps.name: Bing News
apps.descriptionSimple: News app from Microsoft. You can safely remove it.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.BingNews UWP package. Zero system or dependency impact.
apps.gamingImpact: None. Saves minor background RAM.

apps.name: Bing Weather
apps.descriptionSimple: Weather app. Safe to remove if you don't use it.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.BingWeather UWP package. Zero OS dependency.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
apps.descriptionSimple: Solitaire game packed with ads.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection UWP package.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Microsoft 365 / Office Hub
apps.descriptionSimple: Shortcut nag app to buy Microsoft 365.
apps.descriptionTech: Office Hub launcher package. Does not remove actual installed desktop Office.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Power Automate Desktop
apps.descriptionSimple: Automation tool for business tasks. Gamers don't need it.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop package. Independent desktop RPA tool.
apps.gamingImpact: None. Frees background updater service.

apps.name: Microsoft To-Do
apps.descriptionSimple: Task and to-do list app.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.Todos UWP package.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Sticky Notes
apps.descriptionSimple: Desktop sticky notes app.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes UWP package.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Get Help
apps.descriptionSimple: Microsoft automated help assistant.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.GetHelp UWP package. Used when clicking 'Help' in some settings pages.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Tips / Get Started
apps.descriptionSimple: Windows 11 tips and walkthroughs.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.Getstarted UWP package.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Clipchamp Video Editor
apps.descriptionSimple: Basic web-based video editor from Microsoft.
apps.descriptionTech: Clipchamp.Clipchamp PWA/UWP wrapper package.
apps.gamingImpact: None.

apps.name: Phone Link
apps.descriptionSimple: Links your phone to PC for SMS and notifications. Keep if you sync your phone.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.YourPhone package. Required for Phone Link background mirroring service.
apps.gamingImpact: Can cause occasional notification popups during fullscreen games.

apps.name: Windows Widgets (Web Experience Pack)
apps.descriptionSimple: Taskbar weather and widget feed. Disabling this removes widget panels.
apps.descriptionTech: MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience package + WidgetsPlatformRuntime. Uses WebView2.
apps.gamingImpact: Saves 200MB-400MB RAM and eliminates widget web background processes.

apps.name: Xbox App
apps.descriptionSimple: Xbox app for PC. IF YOU PLAY PC GAME PASS OR XBOX GAMES, DO NOT REMOVE THIS!
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.GamingApp. Frontend launcher for PC Game Pass and Xbox cloud gaming.
apps.gamingImpact: CRITICAL for Game Pass subscribers. If you only play Steam/Epic, it can be removed.

apps.name: Xbox Game Bar
apps.descriptionSimple: The Win+G gaming overlay with performance monitor and capture.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay package. Integrates with DirectX and Windows Game DVR.
apps.gamingImpact: Uses ~150MB RAM and slight GPU overlay overhead. Safe to remove ONLY if you don't use Win+G.

apps.name: Xbox Identity Provider
apps.descriptionSimple: Lets you log into Xbox and Microsoft games. DO NOT REMOVE or Game Pass won't log in.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider. Required for Xbox Live OAuth auth token exchange in games.
apps.gamingImpact: Removing breaks sign-in for Forza, Halo, Sea of Thieves, and all Microsoft Store games.

apps.name: Xbox Speech-To-Text
apps.descriptionSimple: Voice chat transcription for Xbox party chat.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.XboxSpeechToTextOverlay package.
apps.gamingImpact: None unless using Xbox party chat transcription.

apps.name: Microsoft Store
apps.descriptionSimple: CRITICAL — DO NOT REMOVE! Removing Store breaks app updates and game services.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.WindowsStore core package. Removing this makes installing UWP and gaming dependencies very difficult.
apps.gamingImpact: CATASTROPHIC if removed. Cannot download game dependencies or updates.

apps.name: WinGet (App Installer)
apps.descriptionSimple: CRITICAL — Windows Package Manager. Needed for installing software via command line.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller package. Required for winget CLI and MSIX package handling.
apps.gamingImpact: Used by our debloater to repair and install tools. DO NOT REMOVE.

apps.name: Microsoft Edge Browser
apps.descriptionSimple: Microsoft's web browser. Removing it can break web previews and settings pages.
apps.descriptionTech: Microsoft Edge application + WebView2 runtime dependency. Windows Update will force reinstall it.
apps.gamingImpact: Saves memory if running in background. High risk of breaking WebView2-dependent game launchers.

apps.name: Microsoft OneDrive
apps.descriptionSimple: Cloud backup. If you remove it, your Desktop/Documents will stop syncing to the cloud.
apps.descriptionTech: OneDrive sync client. Removal requires fixing User Shell Folders path redirection.
apps.gamingImpact: Saves CPU and disk I/O from background syncing during gameplay.
